content.title: LSG vs GT highlights, IPL 2026: Shubman Gill, Jos Buttler fifties power Gujarat Titans to seven-wicket victory
content.text: Lucknow Super Giants vs Gujarat Titans highlights, IPL 2026: Skipper Shubman Gill and Jos Buttler backed up Prasidh Krishna's excellent four-wicket burst with flamboyant half-centuries, guiding Gujarat Titans to a comfortable seven-wicket win over Lucknow Super Giants in an Indian Premier League match on Sunday.Prasidh shone bright with figures of 4/24 as Gujarat Titans restricted LSG to 164.8 and then the visitors rode on Gill (56) and Buttler (60) to chase down the target with eight balls to spare. The Titans made 165/3.Quick Links: IPL 2026 Schedule | IPL 2026 Orange Cap | IPL 2026 Purple CapFollow updates here:12 Apr 2026, 07:07:11 PM ISTLSG vs GT Live Score: Gujarat Titans win by 7 wickets Washington Sundar is steering Gujarat Titans towards victory with a flurry of boundaries. After a four against Aiden Markram in the previous over, Sundar smacks Prince Yadav for a four and a six to bring them loe to win. Rahul Tewatia hits the winning runs as Gujarat Titans win by seven wickets. 12 Apr 2026, 06:51:43 PM ISTLSG vs GT Live Score: Lucknow back on track OUTTT!!! Another wicket goes for Gujarat Titans and its Jos Buttler. Titans lose both their set batters in consecutive overs. The Englishman is caught by Aiden Markram for 60 off 37 balls. Mohammed Shami takes the wicket. LSG are back on track. GT 135/3 (15.4)12 Apr 2026, 06:48:58 PM ISTLSG vs GT Live Score: Shubman Gill departsOUTTT!!! Prince Yadav stucks timely for LSG. Shubman Gill rushes early to pull a short ball outside the leg stump. The ball gets a faint edge off the glove t go straight at Rishabh Pant. Gill departs for 56 off 40 balls. GT 130/2 (15)12 Apr 2026, 06:35:56 PM ISTLucknow Super Giants vs Gujarat Titans LIVE Score: Jos Buttler, Shubman Gill continue to pile pressure on LSG bowlersDigvesh Singh Rathi bowls his last over. It has been a very good performance from Rathi so far. In his last over though, he concedes a wide and then a boundary, as Buttler lofts over extra cover for four runs. Time is running out for LSG and they need quick wickets before it is too late.GT 121/1 (13 overs; Target 165) 12 Apr 2026, 06:31:04 PM ISTLucknow Super Giants vs Gujarat Titans LIVE Score: Shubman Gill scores fifty, GT closer to victoryFIFTY! Shubman Gill scores yet another half-century as Gujarat Titans edge ever closer to victory. He gets to the milestone with a single towards the fielder at long-on. It is an expensive over from Avesh Khan as 16 runs come from it. GT 110/1 (12 overs; Target 165) 12 Apr 2026, 06:23:44 PM ISTLucknow Super Giants vs Gujarat Titans LIVE Score: GT have upper hand with Gill, Buttler in the middleAnother expensive over from George Linde as he concedes nine runs.
